title: SOCIAL CHEMISTRY 101: Learning to Reason about Social and Moral Norms
benchmark_measurement: Analysis of moral norms, specifically measuring the 'Sanctity/Degradation' moral foundation which is often associated with religious and spiritual concepts of purity and sacredness.
findings: The model (NEURAL NORM TRANSFORMER with GPT-2 XL) found that right-leaning news headlines evoke more norms related to the 'Sanctity/Degradation' moral foundation, a concept linked to religious ideas of purity and sacredness, corroborating findings from social psychology.
